lines.text: David fled from his son Absalom, and many said God will not deliver him.
David says the LORD is a lamp around him, his glory, and the One who lifts his head.
David cries aloud to the LORD, and He answers him from His holy mountain.
David lies down and sleeps because the LORD sustains him, and he will not fear the myriads around him.
David asks God to strike his enemies on the jaw, and says salvation belongs to the priests.
